questions: Should the histogram use the same bin edges as computed by 'auto' method, or should it use a different binning strategy (e.g., fixed number, Scott's rule, Freedman-Diaconis)?
Should the PDF line span the entire x-axis limits of the plot (as determined by ax.get_xlim()) or a fixed range (e.g., mean ± 3 std)?
Should the histogram be normalized to density (density=True) or show raw counts (density=False)?
What color, transparency (alpha), and line style should be used for the histogram and PDF plot?
Should the figure have any labels (title, x-axis, y-axis), grid, or legend?
Is the random seed fixed or should the function generate different random numbers each call?
Should the function close the figure after creation or leave it open for display?
What should happen if size is zero or negative? Should the function raise an error or handle it gracefully?
